messages:
maya: Quick bench run: L4 vs T4 vs A10G for embeddings (512-length) and small-chat (64 in / 32 out). Compared us-west (gcp-us-west1) vs apac-sg (gcp-asia-southeast1). TL;DR: A10G wins raw embedding QPS, L4 has best small-chat latency/cost balance, T4 cheapest per-hour but worse tail latency.

bench-bot: Raw numbers (summary, single-GPU, quant=fp16 unless noted):
```
SMALL-CHAT (64/32) - p50 / p95 / p99 / steady RPS
L4   : 45ms / 110ms / 210ms  / 320 rps  (cost est $18 / 1M tokens)
T4   : 90ms / 220ms / 420ms  / 140 rps  (cost est $9  / 1M tokens)
A10G : 60ms / 140ms / 270ms  / 260 rps  (cost est $12 / 1M tokens)

EMBEDDINGS (512) - latency p95 / QPS
L4   : 7ms  p95  / 620 qps  (cost est $30 / 1M embeds)
T4   : 12ms p95  / 410 qps  (cost est $9  / 1M embeds)
A10G : 5ms  p95  / 980 qps  (cost est $15 / 1M embeds)
```
Notes: numbers are median of 3 runs, 95% CI ~5-8%.

maya: Kernel/quant notes: enabling flash-attn v2 + fused-kv on L4 reduced small-chat p95 by ~8% vs cutlass baseline. On T4 we saw periodic fallback to cutlass kernels in apac region which inflated p99s ~1.6x. Quantization: q4_0 -> ~1.6x throughput on chat, quality ~1-2% BLEU/MAU drop; q8_0 gives smaller perf win (~1.2x) with near-zero quality change.

kenji: region delta: apac-sg shows ~12-18% worse p99 on small-chat across GPUs, likely kernel availability + PCIe / numa layout differences on the instance type. Embedding throughput less impacted (5-8%).

maya: Capacity sizing quick guidance (steady 200 rps chat, 99th <300ms):
- Option A (latency-first): 2x L4 in us-west + autoscale to 3 for spikes (reserve cold start headroom).
- Option B (cost-mix): 1x A10G for low-latency path + 1-2x T4 pool for best-effort and embedding workloads, route by policy.
- Embeddings at 2k qps: 3x A10G or 6x T4 (with batching/kv cache).

maya: Example pool config we used: 
```yaml
pool:
  name: chat-l4-prod
  instance: l4
  count: 2
  autoscale:
    min: 1
    max: 3
    target_rps: 250
```

sarah: Nice, adding numbers to the runbook and pricing sheet. Can you drop CSV?

bench-bot: Uploaded CSV + raw logs -> s3://redwood-bench/eng-ml/1758880000-region-sweep.csv (contains per-request latencies, perf counters, kernel tags).
